answer_sentences.text: The sources do not show that RBI replaced the Key Facts Statement with anything else; in the 2025 directions, KFS is still listed as “Annex XIII– Format of Key Facts Statement (KFS)”.
answer_sentences.quote: Annex XIII– Format of Key Facts Statement (KFS) Part 1 (Interest rate and fees/charges) *Fixed reset, other than on account of changes in credit profile Part 2 (Other qualitative information)
